Select IC50 activity rows for human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
